name: Inventory Management System
summary: Tracks products, stock levels, purchases and sales across one or more locations, with low-stock alerts and stock reports.
problem: When stock is counted by hand or in spreadsheets, popular items run out without warning, slow items take up space, and nobody is sure what the warehouse really holds.

features.title: Products and stock levels
features.description: See current stock for every product and location in one list.

features.title: Low-stock alerts
features.description: Get notified before an item runs out, so you can reorder in time.

features.title: Stock reports
features.description: Reports on stock value, movement and slow-moving items.

audience: Businesses with a warehouse or several outlets
